subject: Market launch: multi-cloud regional data handling & retention alignment

Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel@cloudfolio.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Market launch: multi-cloud regional data handling & retention alignment

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. As we prepare the Cloudfolio marketplace listing and internal security review, we need to align on how Redwood will handle regional data residency, retention, and deletion across AWS/GCP/Azure. A few concrete asks from our security and legal teams: 

- Confirmation that customer data for a marketplace listing can be constrained to a chosen cloud region (e.g., us-west-2 / europe-west1 / eastus) and that backups/snapshots respect the same residency.
- Default retention windows for: primary data, audit logs, backups/snapshots.
- Delete workflow for customer-initiated deletes (immediate hard delete vs soft-delete window, timeline, and proof of deletion).
- Handling of metadata and telemetry (is metadata stored with customer data or in a central region?).
- Key management options (customer CMK support across clouds) and whether logs reference plaintext identifiers.
- Any Marketplace-specific configuration/flags needed for listing approval.

We've attached a short questionnaire with the fields our compliance team wants filled. Can you confirm and, if helpful, loop in the right engineering contacts? We'd like to close this before the listing goes live (target week of May 24).

Appreciate it —
Priya Sen
Head of Partnerships, Cloudfolio
priya@cloudfolio.com
+1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Market launch: multi-cloud regional data handling & retention alignment

Hi Priya —

Thanks — this is a great checklist. Looping in Ben (Platform Engineering) and Marissa (Marketplace ops) who own the residency and listing policies. Quick answers at a high level: 

- Region pinning: hosted customers can choose region per account/tenant. Requests routed to the pinned region by default; we also support per-call region override for partners.
- Backups/snapshots: by default snapshots are created in the same region. Cross-region replication is opt-in for DR.
- Retention defaults: primary data 90 days (default, configurable), audit logs 365 days for enterprise plans, snapshots retention depends on policy (30/90/365 options).
- Delete flow: we support a 30-day soft-delete window followed by irreversible hard delete by default; enterprise customers can request shorter windows and provide a deletion webhook for confirmation.
- Metadata & telemetry: operational telemetry (routing/metrics) is aggregated in a central telemetry service for product health (EU/US separation available for regulated customers). Customer metadata tied to the tenant is stored in-region unless the account chooses centralized metadata for multi-region features.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys across AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault for enterprise plans; cross-cloud CMK orchestration is possible but requires an onboarding step.

Ben — can you expand with the platform specifics for each cloud and attach the technical matrix? Marissa — any Marketplace listing flags we need to set (region-tagging, data handling statement) before Cloudfolio goes live?

If useful, happy to set a 30-minute tech sync this week.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.ai

Adding platform specifics as requested. High-level matrix (summarized):

- AWS (default behavior)
  * Primary storage: S3 buckets created in customer-selected region (e.g., us-west-2).
  * Backups/snapshots: EBS/S3 snapshots stored in same region unless cross-region replication explicitly enabled.
  * Default retention: primary objects TTL 90 days; audit logs (CloudTrail-like) retained 365 days for enterprise; optional 180/365/730 tiers.
  * Delete workflow: soft-delete flag; object tombstone created immediately, background cleaner runs daily; objects hard-deleted after 30 days by default. Deletion can trigger a signed webhook to customer URL for proof-of-deletion flow.
  * KMS: supports AWS KMS CMKs; customer can bring their own CMK; encryption at rest is enabled by default.

- GCP
  * Primary storage: GCS regional buckets matching selected region (europe-west1, us-central1, etc.).
  * Backups: snapshots stored in-region; cross-region replication opt-in.
  * Retention: same default windows as AWS (90 days primary, 365 logs).
  * Delete flow: GCS "objectVersioning" used for soft-delete; hard-delete executed after configured TTL (default 30 days).
  * KMS: GCP KMS integration for CMEK; onboarding required to link project-level keys.

- Azure
  * Primary storage: Azure Blob Storage with account scoped to region.
  * Backups/snapshots: in-region by default; geo-redundant replication only via explicit config.
  * Retention & deletion: mirrors AWS/GCP behavior (90 day default, 30 day soft-delete window).
  * KMS: Azure Key Vault support for customer-managed keys.

Additional notes:
- Audit logs & access logs: we retain request-level logs for 180 days in hosted standard, 365 days for enterprise (longer retention behind compliance add-on). Logs can be exported to a customer-owned bucket/BigQuery/Azure Log Analytics on request.
- Metadata: tenant identifiers and routing metadata reside in-region by default; operational telemetry is segregated by region for EU-only customers.
- Proof-of-deletion: for marketplace listings we include a signed deletion attestation (hash + timestamp) when requested as part of offboarding; attestation stored in the agreed region.
- Marketplace flags: set "region_tag" on the listing (required), and include a brief data handling statement that points to our residency matrix and deletion playbook.

Attachments: residency-support-matrix.csv (matrix per cloud + feature), deletion-playbook.pdf (deletion steps and attestations).

I'll join the sync if we schedule one.

—Ben Carter
Principal Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachments: residency-support-matrix.csv, deletion-playbook.pdf

- Can you confirm whether soft-delete tombstones contain any PII or customer identifiers beyond an internal tenant id? Our legal team prefers minimal identifiers in tombstones.
- For the audit log export option, is there an automated daily export to a customer-owned bucket (we'd prefer push versus pull).
- For the CMK onboarding across clouds, can you share the onboarding checklist / contact so our infra team can provision keys ahead of time?

Next steps from Cloudfolio:
- We'll update our Marketplace listing draft to include your region_tag requirement and link to the residency matrix.
- I'll upload our Cloudfolio_requirements_v1.xlsx with a prioritized column so you can map items to the matrix.
- Please send a short mutual action plan (M.A.P.) that lists owner and ETA for the CMK onboarding, proof-of-deletion attestation, and audit-log export. If possible, we'd like a small canary test in us-west-2 the week of May 24.

Are you available for a 30-minute call on Monday May 17 at 10am PT? If so we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
